title: Role leakage prevention tests
description: Write comprehensive tests that verify role enforcement cannot be bypassed. Test cases: (1) DEV agent cannot produce QA artifacts, (2) QA agent cannot produce DEV artifacts, (3) PM agent cannot produce ARCHITECT artifacts, (4) An agent with no assigned role is rejected, (5) Role enforcement works across stage transitions, (6) The responsible_agent field is always populated after transitions. These tests serve as the definitive proof that cross-role leakage is impossible.
stop_condition: All 6 test cases pass. No cross-role leakage is possible. Tests are registered in tools/test-all.sh.
